title: RC low-pass filter
prompt: Create a fully routed, two-layer 36 mm wide by 22 mm high PCB and matching schematic for an RC low-pass filter. Use exactly R1 (1 kohm, 0805) and C1 (100 nF, 0805). R1 pin 2 connects to C1 pin 1 (VOUT). R1 pin 1 is VIN. C1 pin 2 is GND. Keep VIN, VOUT and GND electrically distinct. Minimum copper clearance is 0.2 mm. Place components inside the board without overlapping, keep the connection short, and show readable R1/C1 labels. Produce both a self-contained tscircuit index.circuit.tsx using built-in footprints and native KiCad board.kicad_pcb and board.kicad_sch with embedded footprints/symbols. Do not use external libraries, imports other than tscircuit, network autorouting, scripts, or external files. Return only a JSON object with a files object mapping those three filenames to their complete text contents. No markdown fences.
